observation: agent-map 0.11.0 'search-index refresh --root=.' aborted with SQLSTATE[23000]: Integrity constraint violation: 19 UNIQUE constraint failed: code_chunks.chunk_id on a repository where 'search-index build --root=.' succeeds and reports 13892 chunk(s) skipped because their canonical symbol id is declared more than once.

evidence.summary: vendor/bin/agent-map search-index refresh --root=. -> SQLSTATE[23000]: Integrity constraint violation: 19 UNIQUE constraint failed: code_chunks.chunk_id (voku/agent-ui at 9ac9a13, agent-map 0.11.0, PHP 8.4.19)

vendor/bin/agent-map search-index build --root=. -> Indexed 8907 chunk(s) from 92 file(s); 13892 chunk(s) skipped: their canonical symbol id is declared more than once in this repository. The build path tolerates exactly the condition the refresh path fails on.

hypothesis: The full-build path keeps the first chunk for a duplicated canonical symbol id and reports a skipped count, while the refresh path inserts without the same conflict handling, so a repository with any duplicated canonical symbol id can build its search index but never refresh it.
validated_conclusion: The refresh path needs the duplicate-id tolerance the build path already documents, and that belongs in voku/agent-map rather than in any consumer. Until then a consumer offering hybrid search must treat a failed refresh as a recoverable behind-the-map state rather than a broken feature; agent-ui reports the derived index as stale and keeps answering from it.
